title: STS2 AI Agent
changeNote: v0.15.0: the AI reads the fields it is actually handed. Strategy advice now uses the compact state names, shop relics and potions carry their ids, and ending a turn reports Doom and Magic Bomb as lethal. Each decision also costs less: one screen of guidance, a compact action result, and a shorter tool list. Nothing changes for your runs: no cards, no numbers, no saves are touched.
